senses.gloss: m. (נָזָה) the priest appointed to do the sprinkling (Num. XIX, 21).
units: Tosef. Par. XII (XI), 12.—Trnsf. priest, man of distinction.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:1:33">Y. Ber. IV, 7ᵈ</cite> top <he>מי שהוא מ׳ בן מ׳ יזה וכ׳</he> let him sprinkle (occupy the office) who is a sprinkler, son of a sprinkler (a scholar of scholarly ancestry); dare he who is neither himself a sprinkler … say to him who is …, Thy water is plain cave water, and thy ashes mere ashes from the stove (thy decisions are of no legal value)?; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:1:16">Y. Taan. IV, 67ᵈ</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 28a:12">Ber. 28ᵃ</cite>; cmp. <cite ref="M00231"><he>מַדָּא</he></cite>.
